title: HiTS-CL: A Continual Learning Framework for Long-Horizon Temporal Knowledge Graph Extrapolation
abstract: arXiv:2609.36559v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Extrapolative temporal knowledge graph reasoning (TKGR) predicts future facts from historical snapshots. Most existing methods train once on an early prefix of the timeline and then use a frozen model for all future timestamps. We argue that this fixed-prefix protocol is misaligned with extrapolation. It learns from a static prefix, whereas the target stream is non-stationary: new entities and facts emerge, temporal dependencies shift across regimes, and recurring historical signals must be refreshed online. As a result, models trained only on early snapshots become outdated and degrade over long horizons. We address this mismatch by formulating extrapolative TKGR as continual learning over streaming snapshots. Under this view, effective extrapolation must jointly handle current dynamics, stable knowledge, and recurring historical evidence. Based on these requirements, we propose History-enhanced Two-Step Continual Learning (HiTS-CL),

translated_title: HiTS-CL：一种面向长时程时序知识图谱外推的持续学习框架
translated_abstract: 外推式时序知识图谱推理（TKGR）旨在从历史快照中预测未来事实。大多数现有方法在时间线的早期前缀上进行一次性训练，然后使用冻结的模型处理所有未来时间戳。我们认为这种固定前缀协议与外推任务并不匹配：它仅从静态前缀中学习，而目标数据流是非平稳的——新实体和新事实不断涌现，时间依赖关系在不同阶段之间发生漂移，周期性出现的历史信号需要在线刷新。因此，仅在早期快照上训练的模型会逐渐过时，并在长时程上性能退化。为解决这一不匹配问题，我们将外推式TKGR形式化为对流式快照的持续学习。在这一视角下，有效的外推必须同时处理当前动态、稳定知识和周期性出现的历史证据。基于这些需求，我们提出了历史增强的两步持续学习方法。
tldr: 提出将时序知识图谱外推任务形式化为对流式快照的持续学习，通过历史增强的两步持续学习框架同时处理当前动态、稳定知识和周期性历史信号，解决传统固定前缀训练模型在长时程预测中性能退化的问题。
en_tdlr: HiTS-CL reformulates extrapolative temporal knowledge graph reasoning as continual learning over streaming snapshots, jointly handling current dynamics, stable knowledge, and recurring historical evidence to overcome the long-horizon degradation of models trained on a fixed early prefix.
